hints.title: Prefix Sum Discrete Probability Partition
hints.text: Transform positive weights into cumulative thresholds so that sampling uniformly picks an interval proportional to weight.

hints.title: Monotonic Search Interval Lookup
hints.text: Precompute running totals. Generate a random target between one and total sum, then locate the earliest prefix sum at or exceeding target.

hints.title: Prefix and Search Blueprint
hints.text: In init: build prefix sums prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] + w[i]. In pickIndex: target = random(1, prefix[-1]), return bisect_left(prefix, target).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Initial prefix sum build takes O(N); each sample query executes in O(log N) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Replicating elements according to their weight causes O(W) memory blowup for large weights.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix array takes O(N) space, enabling logarithmic lookup per pick.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of prefix sums combined with upper/lower bound binary search.
